Hi all,

I reviewed the draft listing and flagged the following (high-level):

1) Brand assets and badges
- Do not use the AWS "Partner" badge without explicit AWS marketplace approval. Use our product mark + approved cloud marketplace badge variants.
- Remove the "Powered by Redwood Inference" lockup from the header image — replace with the standard 600x200 landscape approved in brand_guidelines.pdf (attached).

2) Capability claims
- Anything claiming compliance (e.g., "HIPAA-ready", "SOC2-compliant") must link to the exact control evidence or be softened. Example acceptable phrasing: "Supports HIPAA workloads when configured with private deployments and a signed BAA."

3) Localization and language
- Some marketplaces require localized support copy for country-specific listings (JP/KR/AU). If Sunwell intends to list in multiple country storefronts, provide localized asset variants.

I've attached the brand_guidelines.pdf with the badge variants and trademark usage. Harper — please confirm which badge you intended and we can give a one-pass asset deliverable.
